title: Durable Reservation Acceptance Evidence Persistence
classification: authoritative append-only post-reservation acceptance-evidence persistence boundary
decomposition: FOOD-007Y owns only durable persistence and exact replay classification for the missing FOOD-005L reservation-acceptance evidence after a reservation has already been durably established by FOOD-007V and made durably fulfillment-intent-authenticatable by FOOD-007X. FOOD-007Y does not own reservation creation, governing-source policy, capacity arithmetic, capacity admission, capacity-source selection, payment, checkout readiness, fulfillment authority, release, expiration, cancellation, rescheduling, physical inventory truth or physical inventory movement.

discoveryDecision.reason: The authoritative reservation receipt is reconstructable from durable FOOD-007V/FOOD-007X storage, but FOOD-005L acceptance identity/version plus attribution, sourceReference and acceptedOn are not reconstructable from those rows. Persisting those missing acceptance facts bound to reservation_id makes the acceptance evidence durably recoverable without duplicating authoritative reservation facts.
discoveryDecision.rejectedFullSnapshotPersistence: Do not duplicate order, reservation-request, fulfillment snapshot, demand lines, capacity revisions or slot claim into the acceptance table because those facts are already authoritative in immutable reservation storage.
discoveryDecision.rejectedNoStorage: FOOD-005L acceptance identity and metadata would otherwise disappear after process memory is lost.
discoveryDecision.rejectedVBatchExtension: Acceptance is downstream evidence created after durable reservation establishment. Failure to persist acceptance must not roll back or reinterpret the already-authoritative reservation.

food005l.role: Canonical reservation-acceptance identity, version, validation and metadata semantics.

food007w.role: Canonical post-mutation composition containing one authoritative reservation receipt and one FOOD-005L acceptance.

food007x.role: Durable fulfillment-intent binding required to authenticate and reconstruct the reservation receipt.

input.reservationOutcomeDurability: The W reservationOutcome is operation-local provenance only. It must be validated but must not be persisted and must not participate in acceptance idempotency or conflict identity.

successValue.acceptance: The fully reconstructed and validated FoodReservationAcceptanceVersion.
successValue.detachment: Returned data must be detached from caller-owned and database-owned mutable values.
successValue.immutability: Returned data must be deeply frozen.

outcomeSemantics.created: The durable reservation authenticated exactly, no acceptance evidence existed for the reservation or acceptance identity, and one exact immutable acceptance evidence row was inserted successfully.
outcomeSemantics.already-present: An exact durable acceptance evidence row already exists and authenticates to the same reservation, acceptance identity/version and metadata. Exact replay performs no write.
outcomeSemantics.reservation-not-established: No authoritative reservation parent exists for the supplied W reservation ID. Acceptance evidence must not be written.
outcomeSemantics.conflict: The durable reservation exists but differs from the supplied W receipt or acceptance correlation; or the reservation already has different acceptance evidence; or the same acceptance identity/version is already bound to another reservation.
outcomeSemantics.storage-failure: Required durable reservation or acceptance storage is malformed/incomplete, a database read/write fails, or write recovery cannot classify the durable state safely.
outcomeSemantics.invalid: The caller input is malformed, hostile-shaped, accessor-backed, unsupported, fails canonical FOOD-005L validation, or otherwise cannot be safely interpreted.

authoritativeReservationAuthentication.rule: Before any acceptance insert, FOOD-007Y must reconstruct the canonical authoritative reservation receipt from durable rows and require exact semantic equality with composition.reservation.
authoritativeReservationAuthentication.canonicalSkuOrder: Use persisted line_index order. Never sort, repair or infer a different order.

acceptanceCorrelation.validation: Validate composition.acceptance as canonical FOOD-005L data before persistence.
acceptanceCorrelation.order: acceptance.order id/version must exactly equal the authenticated durable reservation order.
acceptanceCorrelation.reservationRequest: acceptance.reservationRequest id/version must exactly equal the authenticated durable reservation request.
acceptanceCorrelation.fulfillmentIntentIdentity: acceptance.fulfillmentIntent id/version must exactly equal the durable FOOD-007X fulfillment-intent binding.
acceptanceCorrelation.fulfillmentSnapshot: acceptance.fulfillmentIntent method/locationReference/windowReference must exactly equal the durable slot claim.
acceptanceCorrelation.capacityRequirements: Acceptance SKU id/version/quantity sequence must exactly equal the authenticated durable reservation demand sequence. Capacity revisions remain reservation receipt facts and are not duplicated into acceptance evidence.

newDurableFacts.reservationId: Binding target only; already exists authoritatively in reservation storage.
newDurableFacts.acceptanceVersion: Initial FOOD-005L acceptance version. FOOD-007W currently constructs version 1.

factsExplicitlyNotDuplicated: physical order id/version beyond the reservation FK relationship

storage.model: one immutable acceptance evidence record per authoritative reservation
storage.reservationUniqueness: reservation_id must be UNIQUE so one authoritative reservation cannot acquire divergent acceptance identities.
storage.acceptanceVersionPolicy: FOOD-007Y persists the initial FOOD-005L acceptance only; acceptance_version must equal 1.

transactionBoundary.reason: The reservation is already an immutable authoritative fact before FOOD-007Y. Acceptance persistence failure must not undo, delete, replace or reinterpret the reservation.
transactionBoundary.coherency: Reservation authentication reads are safe across the acceptance insert boundary because V/X reservation rows are append-only and immutable.
transactionBoundary.acceptanceConcurrency: Database uniqueness constraints plus post-failure reread classification must resolve concurrent identical or divergent acceptance attempts without overwrite.

writeProtocol.step1: Strictly validate and detach the supplied W composition.
writeProtocol.step2: Read and authenticate the complete durable reservation parent, ordered SKU claims, slot claim and fulfillment-intent binding.
writeProtocol.step3: Require exact correlation between authenticated reservation evidence and both W components.
writeProtocol.step4: Read acceptance evidence by reservation_id and by acceptance identity/version before attempting mutation.
writeProtocol.step5: If exact evidence exists return already-present without writing.
writeProtocol.step6: If either uniqueness dimension contains divergent evidence return conflict.
writeProtocol.step7: Insert exactly one immutable minimal acceptance evidence row.
writeProtocol.step8: Require an exact successful insert witness before returning created.
writeProtocol.step9: If mutation outcome is uncertain or fails, reread both uniqueness dimensions. Exact durable evidence may return already-present; divergent evidence returns conflict; otherwise return storage-failure.

hostileShapePolicy.extraProperties: reject unless explicitly part of the canonical contract

claims: one acceptance identity/version and metadata record is durably bound to one already-authoritative reservation
the persisted acceptance evidence exactly correlated with the durable reservation at persistence time
exact durable acceptance replay is idempotently recognizable

nextStep: Capture exact implementation anchors and schema conventions for migration 0007 and the new standalone D1 persistence adapter. Do not implement until those anchors have been reviewed.
